about: opus-first 4:55 — raiders just killed two extractors and a constructor
opus_decided: stance defend (kept), economy_focus defence for 100 s, then back to expand; wished for an escort order

situation.game_time: early game, about five minutes in
situation.rules: The game is lost if our commander dies. The enemy AI's units target buildings, outermost extractors first, and mostly ignore our mobile units.
situation.economy: Metal income is very low and just fell by a third. Energy is plentiful and overflowing. We have two extractors left, one factory, one constructor.
situation.what_just_happened: A small enemy raiding party of two fast light units destroyed two of our outer extractors and the constructor that built them. The raiders are still near our southern extractors.
situation.our_army: Seven light combat units standing idle at the base. The base has two defensive turrets.
situation.enemy: Only the two raiders are visible. The enemy base is far away across the map.

criteria.defend: Keep the army at home to protect the base and commander.
criteria.escort: Move the army out to stand guard at our exposed extractors.
